units.source_text: 内大臣此后一直不再来访，他深深地怨恨太君。

en.t: After this, the Minister of the Interior never came to visit again, and he deeply resented the Grand Lady.

units.source_text: 内大臣夫人闻知此事，也只当作不知。

en.t: When the Minister's wife heard of this, she too simply pretended not to know.

units.source_text: 她为了自己的亲生女儿弘徽殿女御不能册立为皇后，对万事都兴味索然。

en.t: Because her own daughter, the Kokiden Consort, could not be installed as empress, she lost all interest in everything.

units.source_text: 内大臣对她说：“那梅壶女御行过盛大的仪式，册立为皇后了，而我们那个弘徽殿女御正在伤心呢。

en.t: The Minister said to her, "That Umetsubo Consort has been installed as empress after a magnificent ceremony, while our Kokiden Consort is grieving.

units.source_text: 我可怜她，胸中异常痛苦。

en.t: I pity her, and my heart is in extraordinary pain.

units.source_text: 我想叫她暂时乞假回家，让她舒舒服服地休养一下。

en.t: I want to have her ask for leave for a while and come home, so that she can rest comfortably.

units.source_text: 虽然未能立后，皇上偏偏十分宠爱她。

en.t: Although she was not made empress, His Majesty is especially fond of her.

units.source_text: 因此她昼夜侍候，不得休息；

en.t: Because of that, she serves him day and night and cannot get any rest;

units.source_text: 连身边的宫女们也时刻不安，都在叹苦呢。”

en.t: even the ladies attending her are constantly uneasy, and they are all lamenting how hard it is."
He therefore immediately asked His Majesty for leave.
Emperor Reizei at first would not allow it.

units.source_text: 但内大臣坚持己见，冷泉帝也只得勉强答应，由他把女御迎接回家去。

en.t: But the Minister held firm, so Emperor Reizei had no choice but to reluctantly agree and let him take the consort home.

units.source_text: 内大臣对她说：“你在这里未免寂寞，我叫你妹妹云居雁也到这里来住，和你一起玩耍吧。

en.t: The Minister said to her, "You must be lonely here, so I will have your younger sister Kumoi no Kari come stay here too and keep you company.

units.source_text: 她住在太君那里，本可放心，然而那个男孩子常在那里进进出出。

en.t: If she were staying with the Grand Lady, one could normally be at ease, but that boy is always going in and out there.

units.source_text: 其人年纪虽小，心却不小。

en.t: Though he is young in years, his mind is not childish.

units.source_text: 照你妹妹的年龄，自然不该和男人接近了。”

en.t: At your sister's age, she naturally ought not to be close to men anymore."

units.source_text: 就突然赴太君处迎接云居雁。

en.t: He then suddenly went to the Grand Lady's residence to fetch Kumoi no Kari.
